name: DuskCustomizer
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: isylxnt
description: A Fabric mod that lets players customize held-item names and lore with colors, MiniMessage, configurable XP costs, messages, action bar feedback, and sounds.

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Server commands to rename the held item (/rename <name>) and edit its lore (/lore add|set|remove|reset|copy|paste ...) with legacy and MiniMessage colours, paid in XP, with chat and action-bar feedback.
note: Not yet: /item-restore opens the mod's own confirm menu, which Kiln doesn't show.
